title: Virtual LXP campus integrating AI and XR
summary: Creation of a virtual campus combining educational content, employment support, health- and disability-related services, generative artificial intelligence and XR applications.

sections.title: Context and objectives
paragraphs: The project was developed for a French digital apprenticeship training centre preparing learners for professional qualifications at levels 3 to 6.
The objective was to design an ecosystem combining a web platform, educational tools, support services, generative artificial intelligence and immersive experiences.

sections.title: Project management and responsibilities
paragraphs: As Product Manager, I was responsible for managing the project and also contributed directly to selected technical areas.
items: Definition of objectives, scope, resources, organisation and roadmap.
Requirements gathering and analysis, drafting of functional and technical specifications, presentation of solutions and validation of deliverables with the client.
Direct and matrix coordination of a multidisciplinary team averaging eleven people.
Organisation of weekly cross-functional meetings and pragmatic delegation through the Lead Developer.

sections.title: Direct contributions
paragraphs: My personal contributions focused primarily on the backend, artificial intelligence integration and selected administration interfaces.
items: Design and development of parts of the backend using TypeScript, Node.js, Express and MongoDB.
Migration of the backend to TypeScript, Zod validation for reads and writes, redesign of the authentication token system, addition of API access keys and server-side pagination.
Correction of functional defects, including blocking issues, participation in code reviews and validation of pull requests.
Design of the architecture and integration protocols for several generative artificial intelligence providers.
Development of backend code, a processing queue and administration interfaces for AI features.
Development of selected React and Tailwind CSS interfaces, mainly for administration.
Management of prompt engineering and contribution to the objectives, scenarios, interfaces, quality controls and user testing of the XR applications.

sections.title: Collective deliveries
paragraphs: The project deliveries resulted from the coordinated work of the multidisciplinary team.
items: Operational backend and artificial intelligence ecosystem.
Four completed XR applications: an interview simulator, a physical disability simulation, an AR viewer for 3D prototypes and a VR training application for supporting autistic people.
User interface approximately 80% complete at the end of the contract, with three secondary areas still requiring completion.

sections.title: Confidentiality and limitations
paragraphs: The client’s identity, confidential screenshots and provisional figures relating to funding, budget and user numbers are not published.
